dataSourceInstructions:
This datasource is a lakehouse (SQL).  It holds **static /
snapshot** rows for entities -- ids, dimension attributes, and the
foreign keys needed to join across entities.

The block below is the slice of the ontology bound to this
lakehouse: entity -> physical table mapping, non-obvious column
aliases, identifier / display-name designations, and relationships
rendered as ``<table>.<fk_col> = <other_table>.<pk_col>`` join
expressions that drop straight into a SQL ``JOIN ... ON`` clause.
Properties listed bare (no ``= phys_col``) use a column whose name
is the snake_case form of the property name.  Lines tagged
``eventhouse-only TS (<table>): ...`` name metric columns that live
in an eventhouse, not here -- do not SELECT or invent them.

--- BEGIN LAKEHOUSE ONTOLOGY SLICE ---
Ontology: ONT_Wildfire_Impact

== ENTITIES ==

Aircraft  (table=node_aircraft, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, ObservedAt=ObservedAt, Role, InferredFirefighting=InferredFirefighting, HeadingDeg=HeadingDeg, AltitudeM=AltitudeM, Interpretation

Commune  (table=node_commune, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, Population, Department, Interpretation

CriticalInfrastructure  (table=node_criticalinfrastructure, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, Category, Interpretation

Detection  (table=node_detection, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, ObservedAt=ObservedAt, Satellite, SensorTier=SensorTier, FrpMW=FrpMW

FireStation  (table=node_firestation, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, Category, Interpretation

FireZone  (table=node_firezone, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, LastSeen=LastSeen, PeakDetectionMW=PeakDetectionMW, LatestFrameMW=LatestFrameMW, DetectionCount=DetectionCount, ObservationStatus=ObservationStatus, GrowthPct=GrowthPct, Interpretation

WaterBody  (table=node_waterbody, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, Category, Interpretation

Weather  (table=node_weather, id=Id, disp=Name)
  props: Id, Name, Latitude, Longitude, SnapshotTime=SnapshotTime, Mode, ObservedAt=ObservedAt, WindFromDeg=WindFromDeg, WindToDeg=WindToDeg, WindKmh=WindKmh, HumidityPct=HumidityPct

== RELATIONSHIPS ==
(format: RelName: fk_table.fk_col = pk_table.pk_col)
downwindScreen: edge_downwindscreen.SourceId = node_firezone.Id AND edge_downwindscreen.TargetId = node_commune.Id
nearCommune: edge_nearcommune.SourceId = node_firezone.Id AND edge_nearcommune.TargetId = node_commune.Id
nearInfrastructure: edge_nearinfrastructure.SourceId = node_firezone.Id AND edge_nearinfrastructure.TargetId = node_criticalinfrastructure.Id
nearbyAircraft: edge_nearbyaircraft.SourceId = node_aircraft.Id AND edge_nearbyaircraft.TargetId = node_firezone.Id
observedIn: edge_observedin.SourceId = node_detection.Id AND edge_observedin.TargetId = node_firezone.Id
scoopOption: edge_scoopoption.SourceId = node_firezone.Id AND edge_scoopoption.TargetId = node_waterbody.Id
stationOption: edge_stationoption.SourceId = node_firezone.Id AND edge_stationoption.TargetId = node_firestation.Id
weatherContext: edge_weathercontext.SourceId = node_firezone.Id AND edge_weathercontext.TargetId = node_weather.Id
